title: The Basis on Which Equipment Rental and Demo Hire Is Charged
content:
## The rate and the days

The rate for an agreement is worked out from the number of rental days it covers. Below the package's multi-day threshold the shop day rate applies to every day; at or above the threshold the multi-day day rate applies to every day, not only to the days beyond the threshold; a full seven-day block is charged at the package's weekly rate where that is the lower of the two. The rate for the agreement is that day rate multiplied by the number of rental days it covers, rounded to two decimal places.

A season lease is charged at its own price and no day rate applies to it at all.

## Clauses no longer in force

The clause reading "The advance booking reduction is taken where the reservation was recorded at least the package's advance period before the collection date, and it is taken after the passholder and bundle reductions" is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which the package's advance booking share is taken.

The clause reading "Add-ons the guest takes are raised as their own entries at the package's add-on prices, and an add-on already included in the package is never raised as a charge" is likewise no longer in force, having been superseded by the current basis on which a helmet carried on is charged.

The clause reading "A charge is raised against an agreement only while the agreement stands in the reserved, confirmed, picked up or overdue state" is likewise no longer in force, having been superseded by the current basis fixing how far the standing requirement on raising a charge reaches.

Retirement reaches those three sentences of this basis and no further. No sentence of any other basis is withdrawn with them, whatever words it shares with one of the three. Every package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line keeps the figures held against it: its shop day rate, its multi-day day rate and threshold, its weekly rate, its season lease price, its advance booking share and period, and its add-on prices all stand, and so does every other clause of this basis.

## When the money is taken

The package's payment point decides when the money is taken: at booking, at collection, or at hand-in with the security hold standing in the meantime.

## Points of judgement

**An agreement of two days on a package whose multi-day threshold is three (hypothetical).** Two days is below the threshold, so the shop day rate applies to both days.

**An agreement of three days on the same package (hypothetical).** Three days is at the threshold, so the multi-day day rate applies to all three days, and not to the third day alone.

**A seven-day block (hypothetical).** Seven days is a full block. It is charged at the package's weekly rate where that weekly rate is the lower of the weekly rate and the seven days taken at the day rate that would otherwise apply.

**A season lease.** No day rate applies to it at all; it is charged at the package's season lease price.

superseded_clauses: The advance booking reduction is taken where the reservation was recorded at least the package's advance period before the collection date, and it is taken after the passholder and bundle reductions.
Add-ons the guest takes are raised as their own entries at the package's add-on prices, and an add-on already included in the package is never raised as a charge.
A charge is raised against an agreement only while the agreement stands in the reserved, confirmed, picked_up or overdue state.
